name: nagi
description: A calm layer for Chrome: new tab, spaces side panel, command bar and two themes. Reads no web pages.

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -rf release && mkdir release && (cd dist && zip -qrX ../release/nagi.zip .) && (cd themes/oat && zip -qrX ../../release/nagi-oat.zip . -x 'Cached Theme.pak' '.DS_Store') && (cd themes/sumi && zip -qrX ../../release/nagi-sumi.zip . -x 'Cached Theme.pak' '.DS_Store')
